text: Use our own 100,000 galaxy spin parity design, only as a counting yardstick. A convincing detection there needs an imbalance of about 1 galaxy in 100. The rotating parent allowance is about 5 in 10 million. Put those comparisons on the same ladder and the allowed signal is more than 10,000 times too small. Better software can reduce mistakes, but it cannot remove the counting noise built into a finite sample.
